Do not use disposition.Evidence.Keys to infer obligation ownership: corroborating original pages or global context may span other requirements. That broader existing join is presentation evidence, not authority for a blocking guard.
Do not block on optional outputs. Require exact retained source versions; stale/incomplete/ambiguous/unmapped lineage must remain unknown, never inferred from names or prefixes.
For split/continued clauses, follow the exact retained membership after source merging; do not infer ownership from a common page or lexical prefix.

Inspect candidate root exports for root-scoped drafts, which can add the binding. An accepted-plan-only filter must not prevent this legal completion. A nested fixed scope cannot create a missing root export.

A required root binding is a necessary condition only: presence cannot prove type compatibility, actual provenance, conditional availability, completeness or business meaning. Keep compiler and Judge checks.

Keep child closure legal when no associated public-output completion is claimed, and preserve explicit claim withdrawal/reselection. Do not infer every unclosed scope or scalar child output is an error.
Any fresh-only filter/validation experiment needs independent boundary coverage and preserved historical issued behavior; this assessment does not authorize implementation or claim efficacy.
